newsitem.title: USA: Arco raises dividend, sets stock split.
newsitem.headline: Arco raises dividend, sets stock split.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield Co. Monday announced a two-for-one stock split and increased the oil and gas company's quarterly dividend by 4 percent.
The new dividend, on a pre-split basis, is $1.425 per share vs. $1.375 previously. After the stock split, the new dividend payment will be 71.25 cents per share, the Los Angeles-based company said.
"The board's action today demonstrates our optimism toward ARCO's future, in both the short- and long-term," said Arco Chairman Mike Bowlin.
"We have seen healthy earnings growth since 1993. We see an improved oil and gas production profile based on recent progress in reserves replacement and implementation of major projects."
Arco's stock rose $2.125 to $132.50 on the New York Stock Exchange in afternoon trading.
Both the increased dividend and the stock split are payable June 13 to shareholders of record May 16. As of Dec. 31, Arco had 161 million common shares outstanding.
